verdict.rationale: Lindy is an AI teammate that runs automations, so a workflow-branching story is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents routines triggered by a schedule or event and skills that Lindy selects on its own. Nothing in the pack describes conditional branches, filters, parallel paths, or merging paths back together in a visual builder.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can branch a workflow with conditions, filters, and parallel paths that merge back together
